architecture:
System: Payments-Core-117
Primary NIST family: Planning (PL); evidence focus: PL-8.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: rules of behavior are acknowledged by users before access is granted and after material revisions. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
